v.s: After a 0.75s delay, Edith controls Phylax to launch an earth-shattering blow in a designated direction, dealing 225( +10% Total HP) (Physical Damage) to enemies hit (deals 120% damage to Minions) and knocking them airborne for 1s.\nThis skill won't be interrupted by regular control effects (excluding Suppression).
Earth Shatter has a relatively long cast animation, thus it is recommended to couple it with Edith's teammate's control skill or cast it in a bush to increase the hit rate.

Edith controls Phylax to charge in the target direction, dealing 90( +3% Total HP) (Physical Damage) to enemies along the way.\nIf Phylax hits an enemy hero during the charge, it will stop immediately and throw them over its shoulder, dealing 108( +5% Total HP) (Physical Damage).
Onward is Edith's core skill. Use it to protect teammates or rip a tear in the enemy formation during the team fight.

(Passive:) When inside Phylax, Edith can accumulate Wrath according to the damage she receives (calculated before damage reduction).\n(Active:) Edith ejects herself forward from Phylax, knocking back nearby enemies. After that, she takes flight and can perform ranged Basic Attacks, each dealing 35( +75% Total Physical Attack) (+25% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage). Edith also gains new skills in this state. When in flight, Edith gains 350( +5% Total HP)-350( +20% Total HP) extra Shield, 50%-150% extra Attack Speed and 5%-20% Hybrid Lifesteal based on the Wrath she accumulated, and converts each point of (Extra Physical Defense) and (Extra Magic Defense) into 3.2 (Magic Power). The flight state lasts up to 8s.

After each skill cast, Edith and Phylax become Overloaded for 3s, during which all Basic Attacks will trigger chain lightning, dealing extra (Magic Damage) equal to ( +30% Total Magic Power) plus 4(+0.25*Hero Level)% of the target's Max HP to up to 4 enemies.\nChain lightning damage against Minions is increased to 150%.

Edith has the potential to overwhelm her enemy in the early to mid game. With her Passive Overload, she can clear the lanes and suppress her enemy with ease from afar while quickly leveling up to Lv.4.

Unique Passive - Thunderbolt: After casting a skill, the next Basic Attack within 3s deals 50 plus 5% of the hero's extra HP as extra True Damage to the target and enemies around them and slows them by 40%-80% (scales with the hero's extra HP) for 1s (1.5s cooldown).
Unique Passive - Valor: Gain 4 extra Physical Defense for 3s when taking Physical Damage, up to 20.

Unique Passive - Brute Force: Each second after dealing damage, gain 6 extra Physical Attack and Magic Power and 2% extra Movement Speed for 4s, up to 6 stacks. Gain 15% extra Control Duration Reduction at full stacks.
Unique Passive - Arctic Cold: Reduces the Attack Speed of nearby enemy heroes to 70% of normal.
Unique Passive - Bless: Received Shield and HP Regen effects are increased by 30%.
Unique Passive - Immortal: Revives 2.5s after death, gaining 16% Max HP and a 220-1200 shield (scales with level) that lasts 3s (210s cooldown).
